title: Parity register over symbol residues
summary: A register keeps the parity of residues of the symbols read so far, combining each residue by exclusive or, and reports the register modulo a small base.
core_idea: Combine symbol residues by exclusive or and report the register modulo a base.

state.name: pellaro
state.meaning: Register holding the exclusive or of the residues of every symbol read.

learning.description: Nothing is learned; the base is fixed.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: The parity is right after one symbol.

capabilities.prediction: Reports the parity of the residues exactly.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: The register depends on symbol order.

toy_example.python:
import json
r = 0
for x in [5, 6, 7]:
    r ^= x % 4
print(json.dumps({'register': r % 3}))
